name: schedule_search
description: Search lesson schedule by text across lesson title, course, teacher, room, and optional date. Use when the user asks what class matches a topic, room, or name; do not use for a known event ID or room availability.

name: schedule_get
description: Retrieve one lesson by exact event ID, including date, time, title, room, teacher, course, building, and source. Use after an ID is known; do not use for a free-text search.

name: schedule_by_teacher
description: Find lessons by teacher name and optional date. Use when the user asks when or what a teacher teaches; do not use to search a room or course title.

name: schedule_room_availability
description: Check whether a room is free for a date, start time, and duration. Use for a time interval availability question; do not use to list all room classes.

name: schedule_course_search
description: Search course catalog descriptions by course title and subject; returns course metadata, not individual lesson times.

name: schedule_room_list
description: List all lessons assigned to a room over a date range; use for room history rather than checking a free interval.

name: schedule_teacher_profile
description: Return a teacher's office, contact details, and biography; does not show their lessons.

name: schedule_event_create
description: Create a new calendar event from a title and time; modifies a personal calendar, not the class schedule.

name: schedule_event_cancel
description: Cancel a personal calendar event by event ID; does not search or read course records.

name: schedule_exam_search
description: Search exam dates and locations by subject; excludes ordinary lessons and seminars.

name: schedule_deadline_search
description: Find assignment due dates by course; does not return class meeting times.

name: schedule_building_map
description: Find a building and room on a campus map; does not report whether the room is occupied.

name: schedule_room_capacity
description: Return the seating capacity and equipment of a room; does not check its schedule.

name: schedule_teacher_hours
description: Find teacher office hours by teacher name; do not use for teaching timetable.

name: schedule_student_calendar
description: List a student's enrolled classes using student ID; differs from querying the global timetable.

name: schedule_group_calendar
description: List meetings for a study group; does not return official lessons.

name: schedule_time_convert
description: Convert a time between time zones; does not search lesson records.

name: schedule_date_week
description: Return the week number and weekday for a date; no schedule lookup.

name: schedule_conflict_check
description: Compare two supplied events for overlap; does not search for the schedule itself.

name: schedule_substitute_teacher
description: Find the substitute assigned to a class; does not list the teacher's full timetable.

name: schedule_attendance
description: Read attendance for a class event ID; does not return event details or availability.

name: schedule_room_reserve
description: Reserve a room for a requested interval; this changes state and is not a read-only availability check.

name: schedule_notice_search
description: Search announcements about timetable changes; does not return the base timetable.

name: schedule_export_ical
description: Export a calendar in iCalendar format for a known user; does not answer a schedule question.

name: schedule_course_roster
description: List students enrolled in a course; no meeting dates or room information.

name: schedule_semester_dates
description: Return semester start, end, and holidays; does not locate a class meeting.

name: schedule_room_equipment
description: Return available equipment in a classroom; no occupancy or lesson records.

name: schedule_change_request
description: Submit a request to change a class time or room; this creates a request rather than searching.
